seed_selection.table: candidates.json (6 seeds, measured; the images are not published)
seed_selection.rule: refuse a painting by the frame test; then fewest layers_warn_lines; then most layers_full; then lowest seed; the frame test refuses a painting with a border pixel whose minimum channel is 200 or less
seed_selection.rule_note: the rule is recorded in the character config's seed note; that it was fixed before the paintings were looked at is the producer's statement, which the files do not show
seed_selection.refused_note: the frame test refused 72001-72003 for grey backgrounds that reach the border, not for cut figures: the figure stands inside the frame in all six paintings (seen by eye on downscaled copies, not measured), and a grey background makes the test's box the whole image
seed_selection.tie_note: 72004, 72005 and 72006 all have 0 WARN lines and 29 layers. 'Most layers' separated nothing: the wrapper wrote all 29 tags in all six runs, near-empty ones included (tail and wings, which the painting has nothing for, hold 76-81 opaque px in every run), so the tie fell to the lowest seed
seed_selection.why: lowest seed among the three that pass the frame test with 0 WARN lines and 29 layers; colour and costume fidelity were not criteria
